content.short: Quex Tech provides intelligent data oracle for real-world blockchain applications.
content.description: Quex Tech provides a data oracle that securely brings real-world data onto the blockchain using hardware-level cryptography. This solution is tailored for Real-World Assets (RWA), DeFi, and prediction markets, delivering fast and dependable data transfer with verifiable accuracy. By addressing unreliable oracles and manipulation attacks, Quex Tech reduces the risk of compromised feeds and supports more robust on-chain decision making, with an estimated $400M in annual savings projected for the DeFi sector. The approach emphasizes data integrity, timeliness, and verifiability to support reliable on-chain analytics and automated governance.
